note: No commit handler yet. Maps to policy_versions - the effective-dated snapshot of a policy term (premium, payload, transaction linkage), not the policies row itself (see policy.json for that). A legacy term import only makes sense after the parent policy row has been committed and replayed through the real lifecycle (see policy.json's note), since policy_versions.transaction_id references policy_transactions.

fields.name: policyExternalId
fields.description: External identifier matching a policy row imported via policy.json.

fields.name: transactionType
fields.description: e.g. NB, RENEW - must match this codebase's transaction type convention.
